name: MTWS (MAGTF Tactical Warfare Simulation)
description: U.S. Marine Corps constructive simulation for Marine Air-Ground Task Force (MAGTF) training and analysis. Models joint combined arms operations—infantry, armor, aviation, artillery, logistics—with emergent outcomes from interacting force elements. Used for collective training, staff exercises, and operational analysis.
general_score_metric: mission_success_rate / outcome metrics (e.g., objectives achieved, casualty/attrition rates)
reputation: primary U.S. Marine Corps constructive simulation for MAGTF-level training and analysis at Marine Corps Combat Development Command
notes: Specifically designed to capture the integrated combined arms character of MAGTF operations. Supports both OPFOR and BLUFOR modeling. Used at the Marine Corps Combat Development Command and MEF headquarters.

institutions: U.S. Marine Corps Combat Development Command (MCCDC)
